rows.note: Use this everyday term for the person who marks written examination papers, especially in a school setting.

example.english: The examiner hasn't finished marking the papers yet.
example.traditional: 改卷老師仲未改完啲卷。
example.jyutping: goi2 gyun2 lou5 si1 zung6 mei6 goi2 jyun4 di1 gyun2

rows.note: Use this formal term for an official examiner who assesses candidates in an oral, practical, or other administered examination.

example.english: The examiner will assess the candidates one by one.
example.traditional: 考官會逐個評核考生嘅表現。
example.jyutping: haau2 gun1 wui5 zuk6 go3 ping4 hat6 haau2 saang1 ge3 biu2 jin6

rows.note: Use this all-purpose noun for a person investigating someone or something.

example.english: The examiner is investigating the case.
example.jyutping: go3 tiu4 caa4 jyun4 caa4 gan2 daan1 on3

rows.note: Use this for the teacher who sets a school examination or writes its questions.

example.english: The examiner has already set the exam paper.
example.traditional: 出卷老師已經出好份試卷喇。
example.jyutping: ceot1 gyun2 lou5 si1 ji5 ging1 ceot1 hou2 fan6 si3 gyun2 laa3
